name: Cupcakes (Plain)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place 15 cupcake cases on a baking tray, or in a muffin/cupcake pan if you have one.
Place flour, sugar, margarine and eggs into a mixing bowl. Use a electric mixer to mix the ingredients together for 1 minute.
Use a spoon and knife to evenly dollop the batter into the cases.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cakes are golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
When completed remove from oven and leave to cool.
Decorate with icing sugar if desired.

culture.text: A cupcake, fairy cake (BrE), patty cake (AuE), or bun (IrE) is a small cake designed to serve one person, which may be baked in a small thin paper or aluminum cup. As with larger cakes, frosting, icing and various other cake decorations such as fruit and candy may be applied.
